def _get_numbers_distance(num1, num2, max_=1, use_log_scale=False,
    log_scale_similarity_threshold=0.1):
    num1 = float(num1)
    num2 = float(num2)
    
    if use_log_scale:
        num1 = math.copysign(math.log(abs(num1) + MATH_LOG_OFFSET), num1)
        num2 = math.copysign(math.log(abs(num2) + MATH_LOG_OFFSET), num2)
    
    divisor = (num1 + num2) / max_
    if divisor == 0:
        return 0
    
    result = abs((num1 - num2) / divisor)
    distance = min(result, max_)
    
    if use_log_scale and distance < log_scale_similarity_threshold:
        return 0
    
    return distance
